files.docs/planning/inventory/design.md:
# Search and export

**Status:** accepted

search_items(items, query) returns case-insensitive substring matches in input order. An empty query returns all items.

export_rows(items) returns CSV text with a name,quantity header, input order, standard CSV quoting, and LF line endings. An empty inventory returns a header-only CSV. Inputs are validated before either function is called. File writing and interfaces are excluded. All design and ticketing are complete.
